newsitem.title: USA: Tosco restarts mothballed Calif hydrocracker.
newsitem.headline: Tosco restarts mothballed Calif hydrocracker.

text.p: Tosco Corp Monday said it resumed partial operation of its Avon, Calif., hydrocracker last week following unplanned repairs that had kept the unit off line since January.
The unit, which normally makes about 32,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) of diesel fuel and gasoline, was shut following a January fire which killed one worker and injured around 25.
A report issued by Tosco in May attributed the fire to a ruptured pipe.
Tosco on Monday said the hydrocracker began a 10-day start-up in late June and was climbing toward full production.
"(The hydrocracker) went up last week and is now back in operation," a Tosco spokesman told Reuters, adding the unit still operated below capacity.
He said he did not know the unit's current bpd production or when it would reach full power.
